### evidence/oracle.py
1: from pathlib import Path
2: import re
3: p = Path("docs/start.md")
4: doc = p.read_text()
5: links = re.findall(r"\[([^]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)", doc)
6: assert [label for label, _ in links] == ["installation", "troubleshooting"]
7: assert [(p.parent / target).resolve() for _, target in links] == [(p.parent / target).resolve() for target in ("guide/install.md", "support/troubleshooting.md")]
8: for _, target in links:
9:     assert (p.parent / target).is_file()
10: original_shape = "# Start\nUse [installation](LINK) first.\nFor help, see [troubleshooting](LINK).\nOffline use is supported.\n"
11: assert re.sub(r"\]\([^)]+\)", "](LINK)", doc) == original_shape
12: print("both relative links resolve; prose unchanged")
